conventions.horizontals: 1.0 between adjacent columns, rows T-T, M-M, B-B

column_types.vac: T-M A_EX, M-B A_EX, T-B B_EX; A_EX = (3+sqrt(21))/6, B_EX = (3*sqrt(5)-sqrt(21))/12 (vacmod2)

conventions.cp: [cp, a, col]: trial state a on column col; a = 0 the vacres polynomial p (q1, q2, q3) of vacres_K3_N*_sym_v1.json; a >= 1: S[0][a] + sum_beta S[beta][a] xi_beta over BASIS9 on that column, from ts_N*_z9sym_v1.json (as S8_ENTRY_LIST_v3)
conventions.xi: [xi, TM, col]: xi_TM = J(1 - sigma_T . sigma_M) on column col (riglap xi factor, c9 = e_TM; as S8_ENTRY_LIST_v3)
conventions.xia: [xia, [u, v, w]]: riglap3's xi factor ('xi', (u, v, w), 0, c9 = e_1), i.e. xi_uv = J(1 - sigma_u . sigma_v) on the pair (u, v); w only fills riglap3's (T, M, B) slot and no form of it is used (m3_entries_v3 'xia'; kt_sh1_v1's XI(u, v, w))
conventions.K: 3 for every entry (a_0..a_3 plus the certified bar, Lemma U)
conventions.trial_set_field: each record: trial_set = {ts: <name>:<full sha256>, vacres: <name>:<full sha256>} for its N (C-TRIAL), as the S8 records
conventions.copy: an entry with copy_of is not computed: asm9 copies the item of copy_of.key from the S8 record of family copy_of.family (D: m3_s8v3_D_N<N>_J300_v1_8_1.json, N: m3_s8v3_N_N<N>_J300_v1_8_2.json) byte for byte, with alias_of = '<record file> <source key> <record sha256>'; its factors here equal S8_ENTRY_LIST_v3's for the source key

graph_notes.D: S8_ENTRY_LIST_v3's D, for the copied G and Dx entries (not computed here)
graph_notes.N: S8_ENTRY_LIST_v3's N, for the copied T entries (not computed here)
graph_notes.I9: family I9: [vac|int|vac] with Iht's pairs, (3,6) the top bond next to phi_0; F = 16 (kt_sh1_v1's graph NIT)

blocks.S9: the 18 entries of item (v) per N: 15 copies (G x6, Dx x3, T x6) and 3 new (Iht x3); written to m3_s9_N<N>_J300_v1_8_3.json
